headword: {収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}

definitions.explanation: The maximum number of people that a venue, facility, or vehicle can hold or accommodate.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千人|せんにん}だ。
examples.english: This venue has a capacity of one thousand people.

examples.japanese: {収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧です。
examples.english: It is dangerous to exceed the capacity.

examples.japanese: ⟦スタジアム→スタジアム：23905_sutajiamu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五万人|ごまんにん}で、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{最大級|さいだいきゅう}→最大級：21467_saidaikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧だ。
examples.english: The stadium has a capacity of fifty thousand, making it one of the largest in Japan.

notes:
USAGE:
Used when discussing venues, buildings, stadiums, theaters, and transportation. Often appears in event planning and building regulations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (has a capacity of ~ people)
- {収容人数|しゅうようにんずう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧ (to exceed capacity)
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{収容人数|しゅうようにんずう} (maximum capacity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{定員|ていいん}→定員：04532_teiin⟧: fixed capacity — the officially set maximum number of people
